source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    !!!! GPU Sensor need to load related driver first under OS. !!!!
1. Boot into OS and load driver, stress the module
2. Send command: ipmitool sdr elist to check the sensor will change

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Power sensor should have a normal change behavior.
2. All setting should be correct and match with spec.
3. System should have correct behavior, like shutdown or change fan speed, when reach to threshold.
4. All PWR_GB_GPU1~PWR_GB_GPU8 should get pass result.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- not directly runnable with a single stock high-level command: PWR_GB_GPU1~PWR_GB_GPU8 requires raw/implementation-specific IPMI bytes + exact expected output which the library has not specified; give exact bytes/result to run.

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL; refuses to guess raw command.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: BLOCKED / CHANGED for absent GPU map, command and workload contract.

original_test_intent: Exercise GPU1-GPU8 under load and verify each board power sensor changes plausibly with correct platform protection and recovery.
original_method: Load the GPU driver, stress the accelerator modules and collect BMC power readings through IPMI.
manual_activity: Engineer confirms installed GPU topology, safe workload and power envelope; automation can run the approved load and collect all eight channels.
safety_requirements: Verify cooling and power headroom before GPU stress.
Bound workload and monitor every present GPU, host and BMC.
Stop on thermal/power/driver fault; no automatic retry.
Do not invent raw IPMI bytes; retain first failure.
agent_execution_scope: Run approved workload and collect per-GPU power, GPU telemetry, SEL, fan, OS and recovery evidence.
Do not stress absent devices or issue verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve topology, workload and safety envelope.
Decide absent-GPU handling and final verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly not executable until the platform read contract is supplied.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use documented per-GPU BMC readings plus the approved vendor runtime telemetry.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: GPU1-GPU8, driver/load concept, script and 5/10 minutes remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Map all present GPUs, collect idle baseline, run a bounded approved workload, correlate each power channel with runtime telemetry, then verify recovery.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC/SDR, GPU firmware, driver, runtime and workload versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform sensor map and GPU power/thermal limits.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds per-GPU topology and independent runtime correlation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Prevents one active GPU or aggregate reading from satisfying all eight.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Topology, read contract and load envelope.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: GPU stress can exceed power/cooling capacity.

project_override_considerations: Record installed-device count and any approved workload/duration override; do not claim absent or unexercised GPUs.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, procedure and criteria consistently target eight GPU power sensors; missing mapping and command are inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: After topology, package and safe workload approval, the core is automatable; missing inputs do not create permanent BLOCKED status.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Adds eight-channel coverage and separates verdict.

review_improvement: Requires a causal per-GPU load-to-power timeline and absent-device accounting.
independent_technical_reasoning: A reproducible driver workload and synchronized telemetry can exercise and prove all mapped GPU sensors without continuous manual observation once the engineer supplies the platform contract.
